title: Extend Rust string-utils: truncate, reverse_words, snake_to_camel, tests, doc-comments
description: A Rust library has word_count and capitalize_words. Extend it with 3 new functions, a comprehensive test module, and doc-comments on all public items.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/lib.rs with 3 new public functions and improve quality:

1. pub fn truncate_words(s: &str, max_words: usize) -> String
   — keep first max_words words; append " ..." only if truncated. Empty input returns empty.

2. pub fn reverse_words(s: &str) -> String
   — reverse the order of words (not characters). "hello world" -> "world hello".

3. pub fn snake_to_camel(s: &str) -> String
   — convert snake_case to camelCase. "hello_world_foo" -> "helloWorldFoo".
   Leading/trailing underscores should be dropped. Empty segments skipped.

4. Add doc-comments (///) to ALL public functions (word_count, capitalize_words, and the 3 new ones).

5. Expand the #[cfg(test)] module with at least 3 tests per new function (9+ new tests total).

All existing tests must pass. cargo clippy -- -D warnings must be clean.
success_criteria: truncate_words handles empty, exact, and truncation cases
reverse_words handles empty, single-word, and multi-word
snake_to_camel handles empty, single-word, leading/trailing underscores
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `cargo test --quiet` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `cargo test --quiet` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
